_readme: HAND-VERIFIED CLASSIFICATIONS — the judgement half of scripts/analyze-media.mjs, kept out of the code.
Every entry was decided by LOOKING at the photograph (a vision pass on 2026-09-29) or by reading a
filename that cannot mean anything else. `verifiedBy` says which: vision = the picture was seen,
filename = the name is unambiguous, owner = the owner said so.
The analyzer applies these OVER the keyword heuristics, so a run is reproducible and a correction here
survives every re-run. Keys are file names (case-insensitive). Set needsReview true when unsure.
`hold` keeps a file out of every public surface and records why in the manifest.
`keepActive: true` keeps a file in play even when its category is over quota — for a photograph a page
needs by name (the workspace table). `isCover: true` puts a file at the front of its group.
